title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
description: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

title: Glorious
description: A heartbroken man finds himself trapped in a bathroom with a strange voice who says he may be the only hope in stopping a terrible event.

title: Skull: The Mask
description: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

title: MadS
description: Romain sees an injured woman and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

title: Blood Glacier
description: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

title: The Hallow
description: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

title: Superdeep
description: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

title: Mon Mon Mon Monsters
description: While assigned to community duty, teenagers stumble upon a flesh-eating female ghoul and decide to capture her.

title: Last Ones Out
description: A skeptical American is stranded in the middle of a zombie-infected Africa and must rely on the help of three mysterious strangers to make it out alive.

title: Alone
description: Teenage delinquents who are living in an island youth center wake up to find themselves alone with no one to watch over them. After much partying, they realize the island has been deserted and the adults have been infected by a mysterious epidemic.

title: Dead Shack
description: On a weekend getaway at a rundown cottage in the woods, a 14-year-old teen, his best friend, and his best friend's older sister must work together to save their hard-partying parents from their predatory person in the cabin next to them.

title: Mandrake
description: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

title: Infested
description: Passionate about exotic animals, Kaleb brings a venomous spider home, but it accidentally slips away. Soon, residents of the apartment building are battling an army of deadly, rapidly reproducing spiders.

title: Blood Quantum
description: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague.

title: Virus-32
description: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

title: Almost Human
description: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

title: The Sadness
description: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.

title: Devil's Pass
description: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

title: Contracted
description: A young woman (Najarra Townsend) begins bleeding, shedding maggots and hallucinating after a stranger date rapes her at a party.

title: Allegoria
description: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.

title: Blood Flower
description: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

title: Revealer
description: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.

title: Scare Package
description: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

title: PG: Psycho Goreman
description: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E01 — Gray Matter; The House of the Head
A man's drinking habit becomes insatiable, and his appetite grows to frightening proportions; a severed toy head appears in a girl's dollhouse and starts murdering.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E02 — Bad Wolf Down; The Finger
A platoon of American soldiers finds something more sinister than war behind enemy lines; a man with a passion for found objects finds a growing finger.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E03 — All Hallows Eve; The Man in the Suitcase
Teens who go trick-or-treating are met with fear instead of smiles and sweets; Justin brings home the wrong suitcase and is shocked to find a living man stuffed inside.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E04 — The Companion; Lydia Layne's Better Half
Harry stumbles upon an old scarecrow and accidentally brings it to life; Lydia kills her lover and needs to hide the evidence, but she gets trapped inside an elevator with the body.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E05 — Night of the Paw; Times Is Tough in Musky Holler
A killer gets stranded in a funeral home with a mortician and his monkey paw; a former mayor and his followers who controlled a town through fear and intimidation get a taste of their own medicine.

title: Creepshow
description:
S01 E06 — Skincrawlers; By the Silver Water of Lake Champlain
A doctor discovers a solution for weight loss; Rose believes she has found Champ, the legendary monster of Lake Champlain, but the real monster may still be out there.

title: Creepshow
description:
S02 E01 — Model Kid; Public Television of the Dead
Joe's closest friends are the model toys of his favorite scary movie monsters; a public TV station is overwhelmed when the appraisal of an antique book summons a dark force.

title: Creepshow
description:
S02 E02 — Dead & Breakfast, Pesticide
A marketing ploy at a haunted Bed and Breakfast becomes too realistic; an exterminator gets more than he bargained for when he takes on a big job.

title: Creepshow
description:
S02 E03 — The Right Snuff; Sibling Rivalry
A misunderstanding in space ensures two astronauts go down in history for all the worst reasons; Lola is convinced her brother is trying to kill her, but she's worried about the wrong monster.

title: Creepshow
description:
S02 E04 — Pipe Screams; Within the Walls of Madness
A complicated drain clog; scientists fight to contain the creature they've been studying.

title: Creepshow
description:
S02 E05 — Night of the Living Late Show
Simon has invented an incredible virtual reality experience that allows him to join in on his favorite films but is unprepared for when virtual reality becomes his actual reality.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E01 — Mums; Queen Bee
A boy mourns the loss of his mother; a couple of teens sneak into a hospital and end up getting a little more than they bargained for.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E02 — Skeletons in the Closet; Familiar
Bateman blackmails Lampini into letting him take one of the skeletons in exchange for not turning him over to the police; Jackson witnesses a strange creature lurking in the darkness.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E03 — The Last Tsuburaya; Okay, I'll Bite
Dr. Mai Sato comes into the possession of a long-lost Tsuburaya piece; Elmer Strick is denied parole to stay in the prison's drug ring.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E04 — Stranger Sings; Meter Reader
A siren lures a doctor into her trap to carry out a diabolical plan; a teenage girl must fight off a demonic plague when she realizes her family might be infected.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E05 — Time Out; The Things in Oakwood's Past
Tim discovers the key to a strange armoire and is warned time can't be cheated; Reports on the town with a peculiar and morbid history.

title: Creepshow
description:
S03 E06 — Drug Traffic; A Dead Girl Named Sue
A bus full of US citizens are taken to the Canadian border as a campaign to illustrate problems in the healthcare system; police chief intent on preserving law and order in the wake of an undead invasion.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E01 — Cassandra; Smile
Cassie is chased by a monster and is forced to endanger a kind stranger when she asks for help; a celebrated photographer is tormented after an award-winning photograph has more consequences than just fame.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E02 — The Hat; Grieving Process
A horror novelist's agent offers him help to overcome his writer's block, and the struggling author can't resist; Richard's wife is attacked and becomes a shell of the woman he loved, and he'll do anything to help her feel better.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E03 — Parent Death Trap; To Grandmother's House We Go
Lyle is tired of his parents' criticisms; a gold digger fights for the fortune she is owed.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E04 — Meet the Belaskos; Cheat Code
The Belaskos get more than they bargained for when they move in next door to a vampire-hating suburbanite; a father and son bond by playing an old video game, but soon find out there's a reason it was abandoned.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E05 — Something Burrowed, Something Blue; Doodles
A young couple are gifted everything they could ever wish for; an aspiring comic artist keeps hitting roadblocks.

title: Creepshow
description:
S04 E06 — George Romero in 3-D!; Baby Teeth
A struggling bookstore owner finds unpublished works of George Romero, but the comics lead to new troubles; Shelby's mom struggles to accept that her baby is growing up, but hanging on to childhood relics isn't as harmless as she thinks.

title: Creepshow
description:
Holiday Special: Shapeshifters Anonymous
Mysterious symptoms lead Robert Weston to believe he might be a werewolf, but when he goes to a Shapeshifters Anonymous support group, he learns there's something far more sinister than his curse to worry about.

title: A Creepshow Animated Special
description: Featuring "Survivor Type," based on the short story by Stephen King, and "Twittering From the Circus of the Dead," based on the short story by Joe Hill.
